replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Yes there is food.

There is a Carrot Farm in the center. Chests have Steak in them as well.
The strongest is Protection II Iron Chestplate
There is enough ironore to serve a full team (300 Iron Ore) And only 5 diamond ore but there are more diamonds in chests

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
OK: A few items:

  • YML: I corrected the yml, all regions were off about 10 blocks. I am not sure if this map was copy and pasted or rotated etc, but never the less all the region coords had to be remade. The map will load and works now.

  • Chests: All the chest are empty. My guess is that the map was made in one version of mine-craft and then opened in another. I cant confirm this, but never the less all the chests are empty.

  • Signs: All of the signs need to be re-written. Same thing as above, it seems switching versions has added quote marks all over the signs and re-arranged the data.

  • Map: The map looks like it could play well, but we will have to see how it plays due to the ice / snow / water layers. Also, I know the map is a tundra, but it seems a little  "aesthetically bare" in the mid sections and some places in the quads.

Please let me know when these items have been corrected, and we will take another look at the map. I know it takes a lot of time to go back and make changes, but I want to thank you for taking the time to make the map, and submit it on Avicus.
